thumbnails.concept_ko: 왼쪽은 셔터 내린 동네 술집, 오른쪽은 형광 초록으로 발광하는 편의점 주류 냉장고. 그 경계를 소주 봉지를 든 중년 남성이 어두운 쪽으로 걸어 지나간다. 파트 4의 '편의점 소주 +14.3%, 유흥:가정 51:49'가 근거라 A vs B 대비 구도를 골랐다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the lower two-fifths of this image is one clean continuous surface — smooth wet night asphalt — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every subject, character, object, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper three-fifths above it. Photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive brand colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. The entire left half is a dead Korean alley bar with its rolled-down steel shutter, a burnt-out unlit signboard, a lease-notice paper taped on the glass and hairline cracks across the wall, drowned in cold desaturated deep navy; the entire right half is a GS25 convenience store glass wall blasting emissive fluorescent green light, its cooler packed edge to edge with green Chamisul and Jinro soju bottles whose green glow spills onto the pavement and onto the man's cheek. In the upper center foreground, a South Korean man in his fifties in a worn jacket walks from the bright green side toward the dark side, chest-up framing, carrying a translucent convenience-store plastic bag with two green soju bottles clearly visible inside; heavy lowered eyelids with drooping outer corners, gaze cast downward at the ground, lips pressed shut with both mouth corners pulled down, shoulders rounded forward, his free hand shoved in his pocket. A thick glowing red downward arrow hangs over the dark left half. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no large lettering across the frame, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 손님 한 명 없는 동네 술집 내부를 위에서 내려다본다. 앞치마 두른 60대 사장이 카운터에 두 손을 짚고 영수증 뭉치 앞에서 고개를 숙였다. 8년 만에 절반으로 줄어든 술집 5만2,302곳→2만8,178곳을 '텅 빈 한 곳'으로 좁혀 보여주는 장면.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the lower two-fifths of this image is one clean continuous surface — a plain polished dark wooden floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every subject, character, object, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper three-fifths above it. Photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive brand colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. Slightly high camera angle looking down into a completely empty Korean neighborhood drinking house at night: a dense ceiling of glowing orange incandescent bulbs on strings, walls plastered with handwritten paper menu strips, every chair flipped upside down onto the tables, and a stack of green Hite Jinro soju crates full of green Chamisul bottles glowing beside the counter with one single bottle standing alone on the countertop. Behind the counter stands a South Korean man in his sixties in a black apron, waist-up, both palms flat on the counter, head bowed low over a thick fan of crumpled receipts; his eyes are almost closed and fixed on the receipts, inner eyebrows lifted, lower lip rolled inward between his teeth, neck sunk between raised shoulders. A single cold white fluorescent tube behind him separates his silhouette from the warm orange room. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no large lettering across the frame, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 광각으로 소실점까지 뻗은 야간 상가 골목. 간판 절반만 살아 있고 나머지는 완전히 꺼졌으며 화면 상단을 굵은 빨간 하강 화살표가 골목 안쪽으로 꽂힌다. 1년에 2,998곳(-9.6%)이라는 수치를 '한 골목의 절반'으로 번역한 컷.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the lower two-fifths of this image is one clean continuous surface — smooth wet alley asphalt reflecting a faint glow — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every subject, character, object, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper three-fifths above it. Photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive brand colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. An extreme wide-angle Korean commercial alley at night receding to a deep vanishing point, both walls stacked with dozens of vertical shop signs: roughly half of them blaze in glowing teal and magenta neon while the other half are completely dead and grey, several covered with taped lease-notice papers, and the living neon spills teal reflections onto the dead ones. In the upper right, waist-up, a South Korean man in his sixties stands in front of a half-lowered shutter beside a plastic crate of empty green soju bottles, staring down the alley with unfocused distant eyes, outer eyebrows sagging, lips parted slightly, both hands loosely clasped in front of him. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no large lettering across the frame, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목의 따옴표 '이제 다들 집에서 마신다'를 그대로 시각화. 어두운 거실에서 TV 불빛만 받으며 혼자 잔을 들다 멈춘 남성, 창밖 멀리 상가 네온은 살아 있다. 예전의 그 자리와 지금의 이 자리를 한 프레임에 넣었다.

A dark Korean apartment living room at night lit only by the cold blue emissive glow of a television screen off-frame; on the low table sit two green Chamisul soju bottles, a paper cup, a torn convenience-store plastic bag and a remote control, the green glass catching the blue TV light. In the upper right, chest-up, a South Korean man in his late fifties in a stretched undershirt holds the paper cup halfway to his mouth and stops, eyelids half lowered, gaze focused past the screen at nothing, deep shadows under the eyes, mouth open only a few millimetres, free hand slack on his knee, shoulders sagging. Through the window behind him a distant commercial street glows small and warm with orange and teal neon, sealed off beyond the glass. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no large lettering across the frame, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 제목의 '술집도 노래방도 차례차례'를 한 컷으로. 나란한 두 셔터 중 왼쪽 술집은 이미 임대 종이가 붙었고, 오른쪽 노래방 셔터에 업주가 지금 자물쇠를 채우는 중이다. '차례차례'가 진행 중인 동작으로 읽힌다.

Photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive brand colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. A symmetrical head-on night shot of two adjacent Korean storefronts sharing one wall: on the left an alley bar with its corrugated shutter fully down, a dead signboard, a lease-notice paper taped at eye level and a stack of green soju bottle crates left outside; on the right a basement karaoke room entrance whose magenta and purple neon sign has gone dark with only a faint residual afterglow, a microphone graphic still visible on it. Dead center, waist-up, a South Korean man in his fifties clicks a padlock shut on the karaoke shutter, a heavy key ring hanging from his other hand; his eyes are locked on the padlock under heavy drooping lids, lower lip caught between his teeth, jaw slack, shoulders collapsed forward. A yellow sodium streetlamp above pours hard light down the two shutters while everything else stays deep blue-black. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no large lettering across the frame, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 D-2 '메뉴판 앞에서 일어서는 손님'. 001 댓글 1위 198개("6천원 적혀 있으면 들어가 앉았다가도 그냥 나온다")가 근거이며 두 레퍼 대본에도 썸네일에도 없는 우리만의 컷이다. 메뉴판만 발광시켜 시선을 한 줄에 몰았다.

Inside a dim Korean drinking house at night, the upper right holds a South Korean man in his sixties caught mid-motion half-rising from his seat, waist-up, one hand gripping a laminated menu board that emits a hard white glow onto his face while his other hand has already pushed against the chair back behind him. thumbnails.composition: 유리 경계 안/밖 분할 + 인물 우측 배치
thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 D-1 '셔터 앞의 열쇠'. 앵커 002에서 계승한 것 = 유리를 경계로 안/밖을 한 프레임에 담는 분할, 인물을 우측에 두는 좌우 무게 배분, 인물 얼굴→밝은 반사면→하단 텍스트의 시선 흐름, 하단 전폭 2단 텍스트 자리. 다르게 한 것 4가지 = (1) 피사체: 술집 안 턱 괸 노년 사장 → 노래방 셔터 앞 열쇠 쥔 중년 업주(턱 괴기 폐기) (2) 카메라 시점: 가게 안에서 밖을 보는 아이레벨 → 가게 밖에서 유리문 너머 안을 들여다보는 약한 로우앵글 (3) 색 팔레트: 주황 백열+청록 창밖 → 자홍·보라 잔광+차가운 흰 형광 (4) 강조 요소: 창밖 인파 모션블러 → 임대 종이 한 장과 간판이 뽑힌 볼트 자국 네 개. 소주병도 테이블 위 세워둔 병 → 셔터 앞 바닥에 눕혀진 빈 병으로 위치·형태를 바꿨다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the lower two-fifths of this image is one clean continuous surface — smooth wet pavement outside the door — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every subject, character, object, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper three-fifths above it. Photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive brand colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. Camera stands outside on the street in a slight low angle, looking through the glass door of a closed Korean karaoke room, so the street's teal and orange neon reflects on the glass and overlaps the dark interior in a single layered plane; inside, the corridor is dead with only residual magenta and purple afterglow and one cold white fluorescent tube. In the upper right, chest-up, a South Korean man in his fifties stands in front of a half-lowered corrugated shutter, a heavy key ring gripped in one hand with his arm hanging straight down, facing the camera; heavy lowered eyelids with drooping outer corners, slightly unfocused eyes meeting the lens, lips shut with only the mouth corners pulled down, shoulders curled forward, absolutely no anger, only exhaustion. A single sheet of lease-notice paper is taped on the inside of the glass, four empty bolt holes mark where the signboard was torn off above the door, and one empty green soju bottle lies on its side on the ground in front of the shutter. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no large lettering across the frame, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 노래방 2만5,123곳(-7.4%)과 서초동 최씨의 '방 여섯 개 중 하나도 찰까 말까'를 얼굴 하나로 압축. 마이크를 쥔 손이 가슴 앞에 늘어져 있어 '쓸 데가 없어진 물건'이 그대로 읽힌다.

Photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive brand colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. A tight chest-up close-up of a South Korean woman in her sixties, the owner of a coin karaoke shop, standing in a narrow corridor of open room doors; behind her the rooms are dead with black monitors and unlit magenta and purple LED strips whose weak afterglow rims her hair, and a green soju bottle stands alone on the counter shelf beside her under a cold white tube light. She holds one wireless microphone loosely against her chest, its cable dangling. Her eyes are dry but completely unfocused, lower lids puffy, outer eyebrows sagging, mouth closed with one corner twitching sideways, head tilted a few degrees, one hand resting flat on the doorframe. thumbnails.concept_ko: 편의점 파라솔에서 영수증을 쥐고 헛웃음 짓는 60대 손님. 건너편 술집 거리는 어둡다. 시청자 이입점을 업주가 아니라 소비자 쪽에 한 장 세워, 제목의 '이제 다들 집에서 마신다'가 자기 얘기로 읽히게 만든 컷이다.

Night, at a plastic parasol table outside a GS25 convenience store whose glass wall pumps emissive fluorescent green light across the whole upper left frame, its logo clearly readable; on the table stand a green Chamisul soju bottle and a paper cup, the bottle glowing hard green. In the upper right, chest-up, a South Korean man in his sixties holds a crumpled receipt in one hand and lets out a dry humourless laugh — one eyebrow raised while the eyes stay narrowed and unsmiling, only one corner of his mouth lifted, head tipped slightly back, the other hand lying open and limp on his knee. Directly across the street behind him runs a row of shuttered dark bar fronts with dead signboards, the only unlit zone in the frame.
